title: The Observatory North Park

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: With the perfect blend of rock meets elegance, this historic San Diego theater is a fan favorite for your next private event. Showcasing original 1929 Spanish Renaissance architecture, The Observatory North Park’s Music Hall is fitted with state-of-the-art lighting and sound, 45 ft. theatrical stage, balcony, bars, intimate VIP lounge, and adjoining reception space with urban charm. With 25,000 square feet of flexible design space accommodating groups of 25 to 1,400 guests, Observatory North Park is the perfect venue for fundraisers and galas, award ceremonies, product launches, holiday parties, private concerts, weddings or receptions.
